problem: On iPhone the pricing lifecycle/package/billing controls rendered but taps produced no visible state change, while the language selector could navigate to an English route that an offline production build had not emitted.
root_cause: Pricing interaction depended on one inline initialization path. The locale build intentionally disabled translation network access and returned null when its translation cache was incomplete, then skipped writing /en routes even though the runtime language switcher still navigated to them.
prevention: Critical pricing controls have an external delegated click/pointerup controller in addition to source-level interaction logic.
Offline localized builds always emit both /nl and /en route trees.
English fallback routes are explicitly marked data-bg-static-translated=false and translated in place by the runtime.
Regression tests assert touch delegation, English route emission and runtime fallback behavior.
Do not claim closure until preview browser interaction and production /prijzen plus /en/prijzen readback succeed.
